title: Record action menu offers a member an action whose write they are refused (Recalculate Estimate), and the refusal toast is the raw flow-engine trace ("Node 'recalc_each' failed: map … subflow … update_record(showcase_task) failed …")
body:
domain:devx#1 · sunhaolin · session_017xRBcUoS2G4jgqRskpExS7

Found in the 18.3.0 release-candidate browser walkthrough (wave anchor #27377, card W3-UX), at framework `main` @ `c4c515ad`, Console built in-repo from the same commit.

## Repro (fresh boot)

1. Boot `examples/app-showcase` with `--seed-admin`. As admin, invite `member1@example.com` with role `member` (`POST /api/v1/auth/organization/invite-member`). Sign that address up, then sign in as the member through the login form. Viewport 1440×900.
2. Open **Tasks → Audit current IA**. There is no Edit button, which is correct: the member may not edit tasks.
3. Open the header **⋯** menu. **Recalculate Estimate** and **Recalculate Selection** are offered. Click **Recalculate Estimate**.

## Expected

Either the action is not offered to someone who cannot perform its write, or it is refused in plain words, e.g. "You don't have permission to update this task." The record-save refusal path already does this.

## Actual

A red toast shows the engine's trace:

> Node 'recalc_each' failed: map 'recalc_each': item 0 (subflow 'showcase_recalc_task_estimate') failed: Node 'write_estimate' failed: update_record(showcase_task) failed: You do not have permission to perform this action. Contact your administrator if you need access.

Related, closed: #24914 (the same raw node text from a screen flow) and its console half #25938 (FlowRunner renders the inner refusal). The record **action** door, when the action is flow-backed and its map/subflow write is refused, still surfaces the whole chain.
